label: Fern & Fig — export sales report as PDF
_note: Hand-authored example that defines how each agent's Mock prompt should look. `shared` fills every agent; add a `perAgent` entry per agent id to override slots for that agent — the goal is one authored bundle per pipeline agent.

shared.label: Fern & Fig — export sales report as PDF
shared.user_request: Let shop owners export their monthly sales report as a downloadable PDF.

ac.title: Owner exports the monthly sales report as a PDF
ac.criteria:
Scenario: Owner downloads the monthly sales report as a PDF
  Given a shop owner is viewing the Reports screen for a closed month
  And the month has at least one completed order
  When they click "Export as PDF"
  Then a PDF is generated containing the report title, month, per-product rows, and the grand total
  And the file downloads with the name "sales-<month>.pdf"
ac.it_requirements: Render server-side with the existing report aggregation service. Reuse ReportTotals; do not re-query orders. PDF generation must stream (no full in-memory buffer for reports over 500 rows). Fail closed with a 422 when the month is not yet closed.

ticket.title: Export monthly sales report as PDF
ticket.test_requirements:
- test_export_pdf_contains_totals — asserts grand total row present
- test_export_pdf_filename — asserts Content-Disposition filename is sales-<month>.pdf
- test_export_open_month_returns_422 — asserts a not-yet-closed month is rejected

config.testing_context: pytest under unit_tests/; fixtures in unit_tests/conftest.py; no network in tests

ticket.title: Export monthly sales report as PDF
ticket.test_requirements:
tests:
  - name: test_export_pdf_contains_totals
    file: unit_tests/reporting/test_pdf_export.py
    asserts: grand-total row is present in the rendered PDF text layer
  - name: test_export_pdf_filename
    file: unit_tests/reporting/test_pdf_export.py
    asserts: Content-Disposition filename equals sales-<month>.pdf
  - name: test_export_open_month_returns_422
    file: unit_tests/reporting/test_routes.py
    asserts: exporting a not-yet-closed month returns HTTP 422
